description: This Java class `OpenmrsJspServlet` extends the standard `JspServlet` to implement custom TLD (Tag Library Descriptor) scanning for OpenMRS modules, addressing changes introduced in Tomcat 8. It manages TLD rescanning and caching to ensure proper JSP taglib recognition within the OpenMRS platform.

classes.name: OpenmrsJspServlet
classes.description: Custom JSP Servlet for managing TLD scanning and caching specifically for OpenMRS modules, addressing Tomcat 8+ TLD handling changes.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Overrides the init method to set a custom class loader before initializing the servlet.

methods.name: service
methods.description: Overrides the service method to trigger TLD rescanning if needed before processing requests.

methods.name: rescanTldsIfNeeded
methods.description: Performs TLD rescanning, updating the TldCache in the servlet context and JSP options if required.

methods.name: getBooleanParameter
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean initialization parameter from the servlet context, with a default fallback.

methods.name: getBooleanAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean attribute from the servlet context, with a default fallback.
